description: Practice for high-stakes conversations (interview flagship; negotiation, hard personal talks, pitches). Emits already-structured coaching signals and ingests them directly via the structured-ingest adapter — no transcript extraction, no LLM on the write path. This is CQ's deliberate second manifest: the first real test that the platform isn't secretly ShoulderSurf-shaped.
design_principles: Structured mode: TR sends pre-typed patches; CQ validates and stores them losslessly. The LLM extraction pipeline and its sanitizer chain are never invoked.
Trajectory over snapshot: a skill rating's value is its history (Weak -> Meets -> Strong). Longitudinal types append observations instead of dedup-collapsing.
Privacy by contract: only patches / entities / relationships are accepted. No audio, video, or transcript ever reaches CQ — only distilled, app-authored signals inside declared value_shapes.
Every value carries `text`: the shared patch sink keys dedup and display on `value.text`, so every TR patch type requires it (a patch with no text is silently dropped at the sink).

entity_types.description: The other party in the rehearsed conversation — interviewer, hiring manager, negotiation counterpart, or the person on the far side of a hard personal talk. A recall anchor.
A named organization tied to the rehearsal — the company being interviewed with, the counterparty's employer.
The role or position being rehearsed for (e.g. 'Staff Backend Engineer'). A recall anchor for prep context. Note: TR's entity index is intentionally thin in Step 1 — semantic retrieval lands later.

patch_types.description: Top-level container: one job or conversation being rehearsed across successive runs. Plays the CQ 'project' role — skill ratings, gaps, and coaching notes belong inside a rehearsal.

A QuestionRating captured on a single run, tracked over time. The series IS the value: 'conflict question: Weak' on run 1 and 'conflict question: Strong' on run 5 are two points on a trajectory, not a fact to overwrite. CQ groups observations into a series by semantically matching `skill` (the descriptor), not the changing rating word. `rating_ordinal` must be 1-indexed (Weak=1, Meets=2, Strong=3); the sink rejects falsy required values, so a 0 ordinal would be refused.

A GapAnalysis result — a missing capability the user has not yet demonstrated ('no failure story yet'). An open item with a flagged/closed lifecycle that reuses the commitment/blocker `complete` + overdue machinery. User-scoped by default so a gap surfaces across jobs; may optionally `belongs_to` a rehearsal when it is job-specific.
A StoryEntry from the user's story bank — a reusable anecdote (e.g. a STAR story). User-scoped: spans jobs and surfaces in both prep and live rehearsal.

A BehavioralAnalysis metric (filler density, response latency variance, delivery flags) tracked over runs to surface drift or improvement. Structured metadata only — no audio or video ever leaves the device. Longitudinal, keyed on `metric`. `value` must be non-zero where it is the required numeric (the sink rejects falsy required fields).
The single highest-leverage change for the next run. Belongs to a rehearsal and may `addresses` the specific weak skill or open gap it targets, so recall can pair 'what to fix' with 'the fix'.

connection_labels.label: belongs_to
connection_labels.description: Signal belongs to a specific rehearsal (job). Archival cascades to children. `gap` is user-scoped by default and uses this only when the gap is job-specific.

connection_labels.label: addresses
connection_labels.description: A coaching note targets a specific weak skill rating or open gap — lets recall pair the diagnosis with the prescribed fix.
